summary: nav-bar avatar is not interactive — should at least support sign-out
description:
Currently the user-initials circle in the desktop nav-bar is a static div with no click handler. Users have no in-app way to sign out — they have to click 'Manage in Clerk' on the account page (which goes to Clerk's hosted dashboard).

Plan: turn the avatar into a button that opens a small dropdown with two items:
  - Account → router.push('/account')
  - Sign out → call signOut() from @clerk/nextjs, then redirect to /

Done when:
- Avatar (desktop) is clickable; opens a dropdown with Account + Sign out
- Sign out calls Clerk signOut() and redirects to /
- Click-outside / Escape closes the dropdown
- Mobile flow is unchanged (still uses hamburger; hamburger menu can also gain a Sign out item to match)
- Test asserts the dropdown wires the signOut call
